subject.title: fix: make bridge rpc text sends idempotent

question: Should this PR wait for physical-delivery proof from the reproducing SIP-disabled Mac before merge?
rationale: The source change is narrow and tested, but only the reproducing macOS bridge setup can prove the IMCore physical delivery behavior that caused duplicate real messages.

options.title: Wait for reproducer proof
options.body: Require redacted request, response, outbound-row, unique-GUID, and duplicate-text counts for both direct `to` and `chat_guid` sends before merge.

options.title: Accept source-only risk
options.body: Maintainers could merge on focused source tests and green CI, but would own any remaining live IMCore duplicate-send or delivery regression.

recommendation.title: Wait for reproducer proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted request, response, outbound-row, unique-GUID, and duplicate-text counts for both direct `to` and `chat_guid` sends before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the active fix branch and already requested the exact proof gate from the reproducing host.
